atoms.text:
Act I, Scene I:

(Setting: mayor’s office with a big desk and chair. The shelves are full of trophies and books, the desk is scattered with papers. Next to the desk, in plain sight, is a big treasure chest. Mayor Magnolia sits behind her desk with a mad look on her face.)

Mayor Magnolia: (ruffling some papers on her desk) Oh yes, I am good. Really, really good. (laughs crazily) Nobody will suspect me, no one will know. (laughs again) No, I am not only good. I am brilliant. No one will ever find out my genius plan. I will be the richest woman in town. (throws papers from the desk into the air)

(Mayor Magnolia stands up from her desk and paces, laughing crazily all the while.)
